body.text: Hand Fight to Closed Hand Connection via Underhook

items: Whoever connects first wins. The same rule applies to both players.
The top player wins by touching one outside of the bottom player's legs, then the other outside, right after.
The bottom player wins by making the top player fall on his butt, then getting his own back off the mat.
The top player wins by touching the bottom player's back with his palm, then locking his own wrist into his other elbow.
The bottom player wins when his back touches the mat.

options.feedback: Never. Let go the instant he taps.

options.feedback: That is the one thing you never do.

slides.title: What would you do?
slides.question: You're building a strangle from behind, and your palm has just touched your partner's back. What's the smart move?

options.text: Lock your wrist into your own elbow from there.
options.feedback: Right. Finishing it clean is what people remember, the legacy you leave in how you finish.

options.text: Pull your hand back and grab his shoulder instead.
options.feedback: Pulling back loses the exact spot you just found.

options.text: Wait there and let him move first.
options.feedback: Waiting here stalls the finish. Lock your wrist in now.
